pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: PARAGRAPH WRITING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility •
Topic 3.8: Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing, part of Writing 3.1 Guided Writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility • in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How is writing paragraphs in Arabic different from English?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify places where things are bought for comprehension,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. construct a simple paragraph using acquired vocabulary for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate writing as a skill for effective communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify places where things are bought for comprehension,

   Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. construct a simple paragraph using acquired vocabulary for effective communication,

   Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate writing as a skill for effective communication.

   Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to identify various places

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to identify various places

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: Self-expression is developed as the learner studies a picture display about a market and writes a

paragraph using acquired vocabulary.

where foods are bought.

Main points to remember:

1. identify places where things are bought for comprehension,
2. construct a simple paragraph using acquired vocabulary for effective communication,
3. appreciate writing as a skill for effective communication.

Remember the key question: How is writing paragraphs in Arabic different from English?
